headlines.title: Oregon police say teacher tackled suspected shooter, who previously attended Silver Rail Elementary
headlines.description: A teacher "fought" and "tackled" the suspected shooter by throwing her cell phone at him, according to Bend Police Chief Mike Krantz. The victim, who has been identified as Griffin J. John II, previously attended Silver Rail Elementary. The investigation is still active and underway.

headlines.title: Hero in deadly Oregon elementary school shooting is Kaylub Giamanco, father of 2 students
headlines.description: Kaylub Giamanco was driving home from lunch Thursday when he heard gunshots and saw a gunman entering Silver Rail Elementary School, his brother said. NBC News' Liz Kreutz reports on details of the heroic intervention.

headlines.title: Oregon school shooting victims include 5-year-old whose family is ‘broken and lost’
headlines.description: The three children and a teacher killed in a special education classroom at an Oregon elementary school Thursday included a 5-year-old boy whose family said they are “broken and lost” after the shooting and a young teacher working her “dream job.”

headlines.title: Special Report: Katie Zacharia out as White House press secretary after 5 days on job
headlines.description: Katie Zacharia is out as White House press secretary after just five days on the job following a widely panned first press briefing and the revelation that she represented herself as a lawyer but did not pass her bar exam. NBC News' Gabe Gutierrez, Yamiche Alcindor and Kristen Welker provide details and analysis.

headlines.title: Federal investigation of letters with suspicious substances widens
headlines.description: A federal investigation of letters containing unknown substances that were mailed to elected officials’ offices has expanded as some Republicans have been identified as targets of the mailings, a person with direct knowledge of the investigation told NBC News on Friday.

headlines.title: Tech stocks erase $1 trillion of wealth as oil surges to $110 for the first time since May
headlines.description: Tech stocks shed more than $1 trillion in value Friday, as the price of oil soared to its highest levels in five months.

headlines.title: Trump says Ukraine resuming strikes on Russian oil sites is a ‘disgrace’
headlines.description: President Donald Trump has labeled Ukraine’s resumption of strikes on Russian oil refineries a “disgrace,” the latest salvo in his campaign to pressure the U.S. ally over rising gas prices that could cost Republicans in next month’s midterm elections.

headlines.title: Elon Musk shows off ‘flying’ Tesla Roadster after years of delays
headlines.description: Elon Musk showed off the new Tesla Roadster prototype Thursday that can briefly launch itself into the air using rocket-inspired thrusters.

headlines.title: Amber Guyger, ex-police officer convicted of murder, is released on parole
headlines.description: Guyger served seven years of a 10-year sentence in the 2018 killing of Botham Jean, who lived in the same apartment complex.

headlines.title: Trump pardons two vehicle repair shop owners during Alaska rally
headlines.description: During his rally in Alaska, President Trump pardoned Zachary Czuback and Patrick Fleming, co-owners of a vehicle repair shop in Anchorage. Both pleaded guilty in 2022 to violating the Clean Air Act by tampering with federally mandated and monitored devices that tracked vehicles’ diesel emissions.

headlines.title: Immigrant ICE was seeking when its agent hit a man with its SUV has been dead since 2017, family says
headlines.description: An immigrant rights group is calling for ICE to “come clean” about its pursuit of Jose Parra Hernández and to release bodycam video.

headlines.title: Selma Blair ‘did not intend to harm anyone’ in airplane incident, rep says
headlines.description: A representative for Selma Blair came to her defense on Friday, just days after the actress pleaded not guilty after being arrested on two counts of second-degree assault in connection to a physical incident on a plane.
